programme.desc: A man travels back to his home town in order to investigate his brother's murder, allegedly at the hands of his brother's wife. He quickly discovers his hometown has drastically changed...and the residents seem to be under some form of mind control.

programme.desc: A preacher (Gary Busey), who lost his faith when his wife died, performs staged healing miracles at tent revivals until he finds his faith -- and livelihood -- being tested as never before by the appearance of a mysterious wheelchair-bound man.

programme.desc: Young and artistic Claire Linkwood, who struggles financially to make ends meet, volunteers for a surrogate mother program. But after the embryo is successfully implanted at the clinic, she begins to have nightmares of a most "alien" nature.

programme.desc: A biogeneticist clones successfully his wife, who is near death in a coma with no expectation of survival. But when his real wife suddenly awakens from her coma, he finds life with not one, but two wives may be quite complicated.

programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.sub-title: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s

programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion, after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets A Beatnik

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.
programme.sub-title: Mother Lurch Visits The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.desc: Tomás pretende mostrarle a Roger una grabación, pero José le roba el casete; Mía y Miguel planean que Roberta y Diego se reconcilien; Roberta se entera de que Roger está enfermo; Roger finge un ataque al corazón cuando Roberta termina con él.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Font acepta que Santos realice un documental del colegio; Sol logra que despidan a Mayra por recriminarle su acoso al profesor Gonzalo; los alumnos se quejan de las injusticias del director; Lola obliga a Sol a pedirle perdón a Lupita.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: El director les anuncia a los estudiantes que el profesor Gonzalo ha sido despedido del colegio por traspasar los vínculos entre docente y estudiante.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Miguel siente celos al ver a Mía con Gastón. El director Font ve a Sol en bikini e intenta besarla. Alma le ofrece a Mayra ser su asistente. Mía planea ayudar a Alma en su show junto a RBD.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: El padre de Diego habla con él pidiéndole que no ayude a Alma, ya que ahora su carrera política está en lo alto, mientras que el director es despedido.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Leonardo quiere ser novio de Lupita, pero Lola piensa que es con ella con quien quiere andar; el señor Mendiola les informa a los alumnos que el nuevo director del colegio es Pascual; Miguel se enoja con Mía por salir con Gastón y mentirle.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: León ensucia el agua del colegio para poder comprarlo. Roger se hace el enfermo para que Roberta lo cuide.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Quieren cerrar el colegio porque los inspectores determinan que las instalaciones no están en condiciones óptimas. Lola se lanza a los brazos de Leo y lo besa delante de Lupita. RBD actúa como grupo coreográfico de Alma, ocultos tras una máscara.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Pascual se siente un hombre afortunado; Lola insulta a Leonardo al saber que no está interesado en ella; Mía acepta dejar de ser amiga de Gastón; León le dice a Diego que es socio de la Elite; Gastón, al ver a Mía, finge que Miguel lo golpea.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía le promete a Miguel alejarse de Gastón. Lupita le pide a Teo que finja que son novios, pero José los sorprende. Roberta y Diego se postulan a la presidencia de la sociedad de alumnos. Miguel es atacado por un par de matones.
programme.sub-title: No todo es lo que parece

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Alicia le hace brujería a Pascual. Roberta y Diego preparan sus campañas para la presidencia. Lola descubre a José y Teo besándose y piensa que están engañando a Lupita. Mía tiene un mal presentimiento sobre una carta dejada por Miguel.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: La carta de Miguel deprime a Mía y Gastón aprovecha para acercarse a ella. Lola amenaza a Teo por engañar a Lupita. Roberta enfrenta a Diego por su campaña desleal. Después de ver a Leo besar a Lupita, Lola la abofetea y la llama mentirosa.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Diego pide a Iñaki que se infiltre en el equipo de campaña de Roberta. Los secuestradores se ponen en contacto con Mía para pedir un rescate por Miguel. Lupita se distancia de Leo e intenta arreglar las cosas con Lola, pero esta la desprecia.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Roberta le pide a Lola que le dé otra oportunidad a Lupita. Diego le pide consejo a León para ganar las elecciones. Mía no consigue reunir la cantidad solicitada por los captores, pero Franco llega con el dinero y se disponen a rescatar a Miguel.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Guillermo quiere romper con Fátima y le pide ayuda a Alma. Lola ofrece su apoyo a Diego a cambio de correr a Lupita de la escuela. Franco y Mía entregan el rescate. Gastón es el autor intelectual del secuestro de Miguel.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Gastón finge enfrentarse a los captores de Miguel y le ayuda a escapar. Diego intenta quitarle la credibilidad a Roberta. Franco echa a Guillermo de su casa. Gastón paga a sus cómplices y planea usar el dinero del rescate contra Miguel.

programme.title: RBD
programme.desc: José rompe con Teo porque no tienen nada en común. Sol acepta tener una relación con Diego porque le interesa su amistad con el director de una agencia de modelos. Mía le dice a Miguel que quiere hacer el amor con él.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía y Miguel planean pasar la noche juntos. Teo consigue convencer a José para que sigan juntos. Miguel es acusado de planear su secuestro. Iñaki inicia el rumor de que Roberta está loca. Lola promete hacerle la vida imposible a Lupita.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Sus compañeros se burlan de Roberta por sus supuestas alucinaciones. La policía detiene a Miguel. Giovanni aprovecha el escándalo para hacer campaña por Diego. Gastón aprovecha para hacer dudar a Mía de Miguel.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Roberta hará una rifa para su campaña. Lupita le dice a José que Diego va ganando en las encuestas. Mía rechaza a Gastón por intentar besarla.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Gastón le ordena al Pato y al Cacho que declaren que Miguel los contrató para autosecuestrarse. Tomás le dice a Diego que ya no estará en su campaña.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Al sentirse traicionado, Diego hace que Giovanni elija entre él y Tomás. Lupita le aconseja a Roberta que saque a Miguel del partido, pero ella se niega. Pilar convence a Pascual que permita la rifa de Roberta. Mía duda de la inocencia de Miguel.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Diego descubre que Pilar arregló la rifa de Roberta. Alma es la nueva modelo de la marca de Franco. Leonardo vuelve a intentar acercarse a Lupita antes de irse del colegio. Mía descubre que hay alguien inculpando a Miguel.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía sufre porque Miguel se declaró culpable y no quiere verla. Lola y Bianca se reconcilian. Roberta y Jose hacen un plan para sabotear la campaña de Diego. Lupita se comunica con la mamá de Nico al no recibir ningún mensaje de él.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Roberta intenta sobornar a Sol para conseguir una copia del discurso de Diego. Yuli le hace creer a Lupita que Karen y Nico están en Israel. Mía intenta escaparse para ver a Miguel y Gandía la expulsa.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía le inventa a Gandía que Gastón le pidió hacer unos trámites y por eso iba a salir, para que no la expulse. Finalmente, Mía logra visitar a Miguel en la cárcel, pero él se niega a verla.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía va a visitar a Miguel a la cárcel para pagar su fianza, pero él le dice que no quiere verla y la echa.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Vico acusa a Luján y Roberta de ser unas estafadoras y ladronas, por lo que ambas se molestan demasiado y se agarran a golpes.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Pilar le dice a Gandía que engañó a sus compañeros igual que él a su mamá; Miguel decide terminar su noviazgo con Mía; Lola le pide a Santos fingir que son novios; Yuli quiere que Alicia le entregue todas las cartas que envíe Nico para Lupita.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Galia le exige a Gandía que Pilar reciba un castigo. Teo discute con José por el Club Hípico. Raquel le dice a Roberta que si logra que corran a Pilar, ganará votos. Pilar les confiesa a todos que cometió un fraude y delata a Diego.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Miguel se sorprende al saber todo lo que hizo Diego para ganar las elecciones; Reverte asegura que Roberta es su hija; Gandía le advierte a Gastón que se aleje de las alumnas; Teo no puede superar la muerte de su hermano a causa de un caballo.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Rocco besa a Vico, pero ella lo rechaza; Teo le dice a José que sí entrará al Hípico; Pilar le agradece a Roberta que no la corrieran; Miguel le insinúa a Mía que no solo le da besos a Gastón y ella lo abofetea; Diego cae ebrio a la alberca.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Alma confiesa haber amado a un hombre al que jamás volvió a ver y tampoco buscó porque se embarazó; Diego recrimina a Giovanni que le haya robado dinero; Sol le advierte a Roberta que se aleje de Diego; Alma y Reverte se encuentran.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Reverte conoce a Roberta. Mía saldrá con Gastón para desenmascararlo. Reverte le inventa a Gandía que Mendiola es su amigo para que lo acepte como profesor. Vico discute con su papá. Mía ve a Romina besar a Miguel.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Miguel le pide ayuda a Santos para que Romina lo deje de acosar; Giovanni trabajará en la carnicería de su papá; Diego y Tomás creen que Giovanni fue a cuidar a su papá porque está enfermo; Gastón le advierte a Hilda que no se meta en sus asuntos.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Hilda encuentra a Romina y Miguel acostados en el pasto besándose; Gandía se escandaliza al ver la estatua de Roberta; Mabel le reclama a León que obligara a Diego a declarar en su contra; Alma renuncia al contrato para modelar la ropa de Franco.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Lupita trata de hacer que Lola sea una mujer más responsable, pero ella no planea seguir sus consejos. Franco golpea a Miguel al pensar que trató de abusar de Mía.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mía se pone nerviosa al pensar que Miguel vivirá en su casa por un tiempo. Roberta le dice a Diego que Sol lo engaña y le entrega una dirección para que descubra que es verdad lo que dice.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Santos busca cualquier pretexto para estar cerca de Lupita y ella se pone nerviosa. Mía encuentra a Miguel y Romina juntos en su habitación.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Pilar le llama a Mía de forma anónima para que descubra que Celina le mintió. Mía deja a Miguel afuera de su casa bajo la lluvia.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Sol y Pilar planean incluir a Celina en su nuevo grupo de popularidad. Lupita no quiere que Lola descubra que salió con Santos. Diego golpea a Santos. Sol termina su relación con Diego, y Agustina con Giovanni. José amenaza con golpear a Raquel.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: The evolution of technology; how things now considered obsolete worked such as the typewriter, VCR, analog TV, vinyl record, film camera and brick-sized mobile phone, as well as products that superseded them.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: Dynamite explodes hills, drills divide stone walls, and giant cranes pull 400,000-pound blocks from quarry pits; rock serves as civilization's raw material for roads, buildings, paint, glue, makeup, antacids, and chewing gum.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: Barbecue evolved from old-fashioned cooking into modern multi-billion dollar industry; explore famous cook-offs, established restaurants like Arthur Bryant's Kansas City, post-WWII backyard phenomenon, Weber kettle grills, and spicy sauce varieties.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: The technology behind the Vancouver 2010 Winter Olympic Games, including the bobsled run, ski jump and speed skating.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: Built with the pioneering use of steel-wire support cables, the Brooklyn Bridge became an instant symbol of American pride; rare photographs and behind-the-scenes stories recall the politics, the struggles, and the tragedies that made it possible.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: The complete story of the feuds, the mistakes, ingenuity, and successes that made movies possible and kept Edison at the front of the inventor pack; rare early films from the Edison Studios.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: The Trans-Siberian railroad provokes a war, crosses treacherous terrain, and encounters huge obstacles; it's the longest, most expensive and complicated railroad ever built; ordered by the Czar in an effort to save his empire.

programme.title: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: Renewable energy technologies fight petroleum dependence and global warming by transforming air, water, earth, and fire into clean sources; explore solar, wind, geothermal, biofuels, and tidal power from experimental to massive scale solutions.

programme.title: Abduction
programme.desc: For many years, Nathan Harper (Taylor Lautner) has had the uneasy feeling that life with his family isn't quite what it seems. His fears come true when he finds a picture of himself as a youngster on a missing-persons website, proof that the people he's called mom and dad his whole life are not his real parents. As he draws close to uncovering his true identity, Nathan becomes the target of assassins, forcing him to flee with his neighbor, Karen (Lily Collins), the only person he can now trust.

programme.title: The Hunger Games
programme.desc: In what was once North America, the Capitol of Panem maintains its hold on its 12 districts by forcing them each to select a boy and a girl, called Tributes, to compete in a nationally televised event called the Hunger Games. Every citizen must watch as the youths fight to the death until only one remains. District 12 Tribute Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) has little to rely on, other than her hunting skills and sharp instincts, in an arena where she must weigh survival against love.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire
programme.desc: After arriving safely home from their unprecedented victory in the 74th Annual Hunger Games, Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) and Peeta Mellark (Josh Hutcherson) discover that they must do a quick turnaround and begin a Victors Tour. As she and Peeta travel throughout the districts, Katniss senses a rebellion is stirring. However, President Snow (Donald Sutherland) proves that he is still very much in control when word comes of a cruel change in the rules for the upcoming 75th Hunger Games.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 1
programme.desc: Following her rescue from the devastating Quarter Quell, Katniss (Jennifer Lawrence) awakes in the complex beneath the supposedly destroyed District 13. Her home, District 12, has been reduced to rubble, and Peeta Mellark (Josh Hutcherson) is now the brainwashed captive of President Snow (Donald Sutherland). At the same time, Katniss also learns about a secret rebellion spreading throughout all of Panem -- a rebellion that will place her at the center of a plot to turn the tables on Snow.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 2
programme.desc: Realizing the stakes are no longer just for survival, Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) teams up with her closest friends, including Peeta (Josh Hutcherson), Gale (Liam Hemsworth) and Finnick for the ultimate mission. Together, they leave District 13 to liberate the citizens of war-torn Panem and assassinate President Snow, who's obsessed with destroying Katniss. What lies ahead are mortal traps, dangerous enemies and moral choices that will ultimately determine the future of millions.

Warned that she must conceal her status, Tris uncovers a looming war which threatens everyone she loves.

Side by side, Tris and Four face one seemingly insurmountable challenge after another, as they unravel the secrets of the past and -- ultimately -- the future of their world.

Tris must ultimately make difficult choices about courage, allegiance, sacrifice and love.

programme.title: Escape Plan 2: Hades
programme.desc: Ray Breslin manages an elite team of security specialists trained in the art of breaking people out of the world's most impenetrable prisons. When his trusted operative, Shu Ren, is kidnapped and disappears inside the most elaborate prison ever built, Ray assembles an elite team to assist in the rescue.

programme.title: Bent
programme.desc: A discredited former cop connects a murder case to an elaborate conspiracy involving high-stakes treason.

programme.title: Destroyer
programme.desc: As a young cop, Erin Bell went undercover to infiltrate a gang in the California desert -- with tragic results. Bell continues to work as a detective for the Los Angeles Police Department, but feelings of anger and remorse leave her worn-down and consumed by guilt. When the leader of that gang suddenly re-emerges, Erin embarks on an obsessive quest to find his former associates, bring him to justice and make peace with her tortured past.

programme.title: Kill Bill: Vol. 1
programme.desc: A former assassin, known simply as The Bride (Uma Thurman), wakes from a coma four years after her jealous ex-lover Bill (David Carradine) attempts to murder her on her wedding day. Fueled by an insatiable desire for revenge, she vows to get even with every person who contributed to the loss of her unborn child, her entire wedding party, and four years of her life. After devising a hit list, The Bride sets off on her quest, enduring unspeakable injury and unscrupulous enemies.

programme.title: Kill Bill: Vol. 2
programme.desc: The Bride (Uma Thurman) picks up where she left off in volume one with her quest to finish the hit list she has composed of all the people who have wronged her, including ex-boyfriend Bill (David Carradine), who tried to have her killed four years ago during her wedding to another man. Leaving several dead in her wake, she eventually tracks down Bill in Mexico. Using skills she has learned during her assassin career, she attempts to finish what she set out to do in the first place.

programme.desc: A crime lord plots to take control of New York's underground drug economy and distribute the profits to the poor.

programme.title: Raw Deal
programme.desc: When efforts to prosecute mob boss Luigi Patrovita are repeatedly derailed thanks to a mole in the FBI, the only choice is to bring in an outsider -- specifically, Mark Kaminsky, a disgraced agent who leaps at a chance for reinstatement. After FBI chief Shannon gives him his orders, Kaminsky fakes his death and reemerges as an ex-con named Brenner. Undercover and accountable to no one, the former Fed tears up the mob from the inside.

programme.title: Manhunter
programme.desc: FBI criminal profiler Will Graham (William Petersen) is called out of early retirement to assist on a serial murder case involving a killer known as the "Tooth Fairy" (Tom Noonan). Graham enlists the help of imprisoned serial killer -- and cannibal -- Dr. Hannibal Lecter (Brian Cox), who is the reason Graham took an early retirement. Soon, Graham and the FBI are entangled in a deadly cat-and-mouse game between the Tooth Fairy, Lecter and an interfering journalist (Stephen Lang).

programme.title: Bad Lieutenant
programme.desc: The Lieutenant (Harvey Keitel) is a corrupt cop steeped in gambling debt who exploits his authority to sexually harass teenage girls, embezzle money and abuse drugs. His troubles come to a head when a mob lackey delivers an ultimatum: pay off his debt, or else. His fate appears sealed. But when The Lieutenant learns that a $50,000 reward is being offered to whoever catches a pair of thugs who raped a nun (Frankie Thorn), he jumps at the opportunity, hoping that he can still redeem himself.

programme.title: Light Sleeper
programme.desc: A Manhattan drug dealer with a wealthy clientele, John LeTour reevaluates both his trade and his life after discovering that his supplier, Ann, is planning on quitting the business. When John runs into his old flame Marianne, he sees reconnecting with her as a way to change for the better, but she is reluctant to rekindle the romance. But Danvers State Mental Hospital, closed down for 15 years, is about to receive five new visitors.

Then one day he sees one of his fraternity brothers kill a young woman -- a crime that Ryan must keep secret if he is to remain a Skull. While Kelly (Lindy Booth), a good friend, pushes him to follow his conscience, Ryan's girlfriend, Ali (Ashley Lyn Cafagna), surprises him by being against his snitching.

programme.title: Conan the Barbarian
programme.desc: A powerful Cimmerian warrior, Conan carves a bloody path across the land of Hyboria on a personal vendetta. That soon turns into an epic battle against evil, for Conan's mortal enemy, Khalar Zym, seeks the legendary Mask of Acheron. The artifact will enable Khalar Zym to raise his wife from the dead and achieve immortality for himself, but it will also unleash a malevolent force upon the land, and only Conan and his companions can stop it.

programme.title: Gods of Egypt
programme.desc: The survival of mankind hangs in the balance when Set, the merciless god of darkness, usurps Egypt's throne and plunges the prosperous empire into chaos and conflict. Hoping to save the world and rescue his true love, a defiant mortal named Bek forms an unlikely alliance with the powerful god Horus. Their battle against Set and his henchmen takes them into the afterlife and across the heavens for an epic confrontation.

programme.title: The Last Witch Hunter
programme.desc: The modern world holds many secrets, the most astounding being that witches still live among us. Centuries ago, Kaulder managed to slay the all-powerful Witch Queen, decimating her followers in the process. Before her death, she cursed the valiant warrior with her own immortality, separating him from his beloved wife and daughter in the afterlife. Her resurrection now threatens the survival of the human race as Kaulder, the only one of his kind remaining, faces her vengeful wrath.

programme.title: The Legend of Hercules
programme.desc: As the son of Zeus, king of the gods, and a mortal woman, Hercules (Kellan Lutz) is blessed with extraordinary strength. Caught in a forbidden love, Hercules is exiled by his stepfather, the king, and sold into slavery. The legendary strongman endures harrowing battles and death matches in the gladiators' arena, and must use his formidable powers to fight his way back to his rightful kingdom, overthrow its traitorous ruler and restore peace to the land.

programme.title: Snowpiercer
programme.desc: A post-apocalyptic ice age forces humanity's last survivors aboard a globe-spanning supertrain. One man will risk everything to lead a revolt for control of the engine and the future of the world.

programme.title: Sisu
programme.desc: During the last days of World War II, a solitary prospector crosses paths with Nazis on a scorched-Earth retreat in northern Finland. When the soldiers decide to steal his gold, they quickly discover they just tangled with no ordinary miner.

programme.title: Boy Kills World
programme.desc: Boy is a mayhem machine who's been training to assassinate the bloodthirsty Hilda Van Der Koy and avenge his family's murder; guided by his sister's mischievous spirit, Boy uncovers one stunning revelation after another as he barrels toward Hilda.

programme.title: Crank
programme.desc: Chev Chelios (Jason Statham), a hit man wanting to go straight, lets his latest target slip away, then he awakes the next morning to a phone call that informs him he has been poisoned and has only an hour to live unless he keeps adrenaline coursing through his body while he searches for an antidote.

programme.title: Crank: High Voltage
programme.desc: After surviving an incredible plunge to near-certain death, Chev Chelios is abducted by Chinese mobsters. Waking up three months later, Chev finds that his nearly indestructible heart has been replaced with a battery-operated device that requires regular jolts of electricity, or it will fail. Chev escapes from his captors, reunites with his lover, Eve, and sets out on a frantic chase through Los Angeles to get his real heart back.

programme.title: Red
programme.desc: After surviving an assault from a squad of hit men, retired CIA agent Frank Moses (Bruce Willis) reassembles his old team for an all-out war. Frank reunites with old Joe (Morgan Freeman), crazy Marvin (John Malkovich) and wily Victoria (Helen Mirren) to uncover a massive conspiracy that threatens their lives. Only their expert training will allow them to survive a near-impossible mission -- breaking into CIA headquarters.

programme.title: Red 2
programme.desc: Former CIA black-ops agent Frank Moses (Bruce Willis) and his old partner, Marvin Boggs (John Malkovich), are caught in the grip of retirement -- but that soon changes when a powerful Cold War weapon known as Nightshade resurfaces decades after its disappearance. With assassins hot on their trail, Frank and his team set out to find the one scientist (Anthony Hopkins) who can unravel the mystery of Nightshade and help them save themselves -- and the world.

programme.title: Sisu
programme.desc: During the last days of World War II, a solitary prospector crosses paths with Nazis on a scorched-Earth retreat in northern Finland. When the soldiers decide to steal his gold, they quickly discover they just tangled with no ordinary miner.

programme.title: Iron Mask
programme.desc: To save his homeland from certain doom, a kung fu master must escape from the maniacal James Hook in order to send his daughter a secret talisman that will allow her to control a massive and mythical dragon.

programme.title: Future World
programme.desc: A queen lays dying as her son, Prince, travels across a barren wasteland to find a near-mythical medicine to save her life. After evading violent raiders on motorbikes led by the Warlord and his enforcer, Prince meets Ash, a robotic assassin in search of its own soul. When the Druglord captures Prince, he soon finds himself in an epic battle to save the last remnants of humanity.

programme.title: Gamer
programme.desc: Each week Kable, a death-row inmate, battles his fellow prisoners in a violent online game called "Slayers," his every move controlled by a young gamer's remote device. To the players, Kable and the other inmates are just simulated characters. But, to a resistance group that opposes the game's inventor, Kable is a critical component of their plan to end the inventor's form of high-tech slavery.

programme.title: Dredd
programme.desc: Mega City One is a vast, violent metropolis where felons rule the streets. The only law lies with cops called "judges," who act as judge, jury and executioner, and Dredd (Karl Urban) is one of the city's most feared. One day, Dredd is partnered with Cassandra (Olivia Thirlby), a rookie with powerful psychic abilities. A report of a terrible crime sends Dredd and Cassandra to a dangerous area controlled by Ma-Ma (Lena Headey), a drug lord who will stop at nothing to protect her empire.

programme.title: Punisher: War Zone
programme.desc: Frank Castle, aka The Punisher (Ray Stevenson), turns the streets of New York City red as he wages a one-man war against the crime syndicate responsible for the death of his wife and two kids. Aided by his trusted sidekick, Microchip (Wayne Knight), he almost kills Billy Russoti (Dominic West) and leaves him horribly disfigured. Billy renames himself Jigsaw and with the help of his crazed brother Loony Bin Jim, recruits criminals from every corner of the city to do battle with Frank.

programme.title: Freaky Tales
programme.desc: An NBA star, a corrupt cop, a female rap duo, teenage punks, neo-Nazis and a debt collector embark on a collision course in 1987 Oakland, Calif.

programme.title: El rey de los albures
programme.desc: Un vendedor de tacos famoso por sus chistes participa en un concurso de baile con su ahijada para poder pagar una deuda.

programme.title: Acapulqueña
programme.desc: Un millonario decide montar un espectáculo con una mujer de Acapulco y dos hombres se enamoran de ella.

programme.title: Santo: Infraterrestre
programme.desc: Las fuerzas del bien se enfrentan a las malévolas intenciones de los Infraterrestres, seres de otro planeta que intentarán apoderarse de la Tierra.

programme.title: Adiós, New York, adiós
programme.desc: La ciudad de Nueva York es el escenario donde se juntan varias historias protagonizadas por latinos. Una familia puertorriqueña, dos mexicanos y sus amigos buscan fortuna sin olvidar sus raíces y tradiciones.

programme.title: El Mofles y Canek en máscara vs cabellera
programme.desc: Un mecánico inexperto en el deporte de la lucha libre vive toda una aventura cuando se enfrenta a un luchador asesino.

programme.title: Barridos y regados
programme.desc: Cuando dos mensajeros llegan con un recado a una empresa, los confunden con los técnicos a los que esperaban y ellos aprovechan la situación para ganar dinero e impresionar a las bellas secretarias.

programme.title: Mágico, el Enviado de los Dioses
programme.desc: Un héroe enmascarado llamado Mágico llega a la Tierra para pelear contra una fuerza maléfica y defender a los necesitados.

programme.title: La hora del jaguar
programme.desc: Como agente de la policía se caracterizó por ser el más despiadado, ahora retirado, se convierte en asesino a sueldo.

programme.title: El mexicano
programme.desc: Jacinto, un peleador que vence a todos sus rivales en Estados Unidos, ayuda a su hermano que es atacado por unos irlandeses. El antiguo rival de Jacinto mata a su esposa, por lo que Jacinto busca vengarse.

programme.title: Escuadrón salvaje
programme.desc: Los juegos de guerra se tornan mortales para un grupo de jóvenes, cuya alegre excursión culmina en una casa abandonada.

programme.title: Juan Nadie
programme.desc: Juan Nadie es un pistolero al que contratan para matar a un cacique. Juan lo hace y la viuda de este pone precio a su cabeza. Su mala fama lo lleva a ser perseguido por una banda.

programme.title: El Triángulo del Crimen
programme.desc: Un hombre sale de la cárcel, busca la ayuda de un viejo amigo y comprende que entre ellos aún existe la rivalidad que inició durante su infancia.

programme.title: Asesino del Metro
programme.desc: El miedo se impone sobre la Ciudad de México, cuando un asesino a sus víctimas, todas mujeres, en el metro de la ciudad.

programme.title: Por el Poder de la Mara
programme.desc: Un grupo de mafiosos desata una guerra cuando la esposa de un personaje clave para su organización es secuestrada.

programme.title: El corrido de María Pistolas
programme.desc: Un hombre finge estar del lado de los ricos para enterarse de sus planes, y así los revolucionarios venzan en un ataque.

programme.title: Reencuentros
programme.desc: Al morir su hermano de leucemia, un niño pobre toma su bicicleta y emprende un viaje a la ciudad en busca de su padre.

programme.title: El caudillo
programme.desc: Un valiente revolucionario es buscado por las tropas federales, pero el pueblo lo ayuda a esconderse y luego a escapar.

programme.title: Señoritas a Disgusto
programme.desc: Tres mujeres que viven en un pueblo lleno de solteronas alquilan una de sus habitaciones a un apuesto hombre.

programme.title: La Chamuscada
programme.desc: Un peón se une a la revolución y llega a ser coronel de las tropas zapatistas después de huir del maltrato de su patrón.

programme.title: Lázaro Cárdenas
programme.desc: En el pueblo de Palmira, Carranza, se instruye a los niños de las escuelas sobre la labor que el general Cárdenas realizó en México.

programme.title: Renuncia por motivos de salud
programme.desc: Un empleado del gobierno quiere alejarse de la corrupción, pero se ve atrapado entre perderlo todo o unirse al juego.
